title: Production Durable Knowledge Graph Insight Integration
objective: Integrate authoritative durable KnowledgeGraph retrieval with deterministic Knowledge reasoning and deterministic Knowledge insight creation so callers can request an insight against a persisted graph without supplying or replacing the authoritative reasoning result.
architecture: Accept an explicit caller persistence key.
Accept caller-owned KnowledgeInsightRequest metadata without its reasoning field.
Retrieve the durable KnowledgeGraph exactly once through KnowledgeGraphPersistence.retrieve.
Execute reasoning exactly once against the retrieved graph.
Construct the KnowledgeInsightRequest using the exact reasoning result produced by that execution.
Execute insight creation exactly once and return the existing KnowledgeInsightEngineResult unchanged.
Do not grant persistence authority to reasoning or insight engines.
Do not grant insight callers authority to inject a reasoning result.
Do not broaden network, deployment, publication, orchestration, or unrelated persistence authority.
failureSemantics: Retrieval failure propagates unchanged and prevents reasoning and insight creation.
Reasoning failure propagates unchanged and prevents insight creation.
Insight failure propagates unchanged after exactly one successful retrieval and one successful reasoning execution.
